title: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent in Power Systems
summary: China Southern Power Grid's AI company reports that its Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent outperformed human dispatchers in control evaluations on a regional grid.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Southern Power Grid Artificial Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd. developed a flow-control agent for power dispatch. Human dispatchers adjust generation by experience, with decisions taken at the scale of minutes. The developer reports that the agent is deployed in the southwestern Chinese regional power grid, where it adjusts generation outputs in real time. It reports that the agent outperformed human dispatchers in comprehensive control evaluations. It also states that decisions can move to the scale of seconds. Development of the agent continues. The account provides no independent verification of this gain. Energy and emissions benefits remain unquantified.
purpose: Optimize power dispatch while maintaining transmission and stability constraints.
system: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent
developer: China Southern Power Grid Artificial Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd.

ratings.reason: The developer reports that the deployed agent outperformed human dispatchers in comprehensive control evaluations. No source gives the size of the improvement.
More renewable energy and lower emissions are intended benefits, and no source measures their extent.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: China Southern Power Grid Artificial Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd., Use Case 3 in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, Report 2025. Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent in Power Systems
evidence.quote: consistently outperforming human dispatchers in comprehensive control evaluations

evidence.citation: Dai Zhen, 广西电网公司发布断面调控智能体 (Guangxi Power Grid releases a grid-section control agent), China Energy News, 16 June 2025, p. 11. Dai Zhen, China Southern Power Grid's contact for the project, writes that the agent went online at the end of 2024 and made the control of grid sections faster and safer.
evidence.title: 广西电网公司发布断面调控智能体
evidence.quote: 该智能体是广西电网公司联合南网数字集团、基于大瓦特-天璇大模型开发的调度运行融合智能体，融合强化学习算法，实现对电网断面状态的秒级感知、智能预测与自主调控。自2024年底上线以来，显著提升了正常态与极端故障场景下的电网断面控制及时性及安全水平。

evidence.citation: China Energy News, 南方电网AI成果亮相“人工智能向善全球峰会”并获奖 (China Southern Power Grid's AI results win an award at the AI for Good Global Summit), ifeng.com, 14 July 2025. China Energy News relays China Southern Power Grid's own account: The agent won an Innovate for Impact award at the summit.
evidence.title: 南方电网AI成果亮相“人工智能向善全球峰会”并获奖
evidence.quote: 南方电网公司获奖案例“新型电力系统断面控制智能体”，由南方总调、广西电网公司与南网数字集团联合研发并落地实施，可毫秒级完成上千机组策略推演，将传统15分钟推算压缩至秒级，已在省中调调度台上线使用

evidence.citation: Wei Lu, Chen Qinrong and Lu Dongqi, 人工智能开启广西电网数智变革新图景 (AI opens a new picture of digital change at Guangxi Power Grid), China Energy News, 22 September 2025, p. 11. The three writers report for Guangxi Power Grid, which built and runs the agent. They write that it had run at the Guangxi dispatch desk for more than eight months and that it controls the grid nearly as well as human dispatchers.
evidence.title: 人工智能开启广西电网数智变革新图景
evidence.quote: 为此，广西电网公司基于南方电网“大瓦特-天璇”电力调度AI大模型和边缘计算集群系统开发了电网断面调控智能体，运用AI大模型强化学习技术，通过百万次训练，实现接近人类调度员调控能力，以应对高比例新能源给电网带来的冲击。 电网断面调控智能体已在广西电网调度台上线使用8个多月，监控范围包括全区600余个厂站、90多个断面
